comparisons.why: A fixes Locataire with a conventioned social landlord (FR-APL-1 CONVERSION.md:84-90); B fixes the applicant Française (CONVERSION_2.md:42-51). B's eight date bands refine A's bands from 2019-09-01 on (A CONVERSION.md:40-47, B CONVERSION_2.md:74-84).

B fixes date_courante 2020-03-10 (FR-APL-4 CONVERSION_2.md:103), A's representative of 2019-09-01_to_2020-12-31 (FR-APL-1 CONVERSION.md:44); B keeps three territories; the other B attributes are held at Exemple1's values, which A fixes.

Both fix 2020-03-10 and Exemple1's household; k dependants are the first k children of Exemple1 on both sides for k <= 3 (A FR-APL-2 CONVERSION.md:31-33, B FR-APL-5 CONVERSION_2.md:82-86). B's 23 surface bands refine A's 16 (A :52-56, B :87-93).

Both fix 2020-03-10 and Exemple1's household. Shares: B's parts_10pct and parts_above_10pct lie in A's famille_10pc_ou_plus (A FR-APL-3 CONVERSION.md:35-40, B FR-APL-4 CONVERSION_2.md:91-94). Third party's age: B's 30th_birthday_on_date and over_30 lie in A's 30_ans_ou_plus (A :41-48 and band check :71-75, B :83-90).
A fixes 2020-03-10, Métropole (FR-APL-3 CONVERSION.md:50-55); B's band holding that date has 2020-03-10 as representative (FR-APL-1 CONVERSION_2.md:78).

Same six inputs. Fixed inputs differ: A's applicant is Étrangère {l512_2: vrai, art_4_mayotte: vrai} (FR-APL-4 CONVERSION.md:45-48), B's is Exemple1's Française (FR-APL-2 CONVERSION_2.md:107-113); date_conventionnement 2000-01-01 (A) and 2010-01-01 (B), which both coders record as unread by eligibility. B's date bands refine A's (A CONVERSION.md:33, B :74-84).

A fixes Métropole (FR-APL-5 CONVERSION.md:53), B fixes résidence_principale vrai (FR-APL-3 CONVERSION_2.md:123). Loan records differ (A: 500 €, entry 2010-01-01; B: 700 €, entry = earlier of signature and decision date), recorded by both as unread by eligibility.

B's ten period-list shapes each fall on one side of 730 days (B CONVERSION_2.md:45-56); B's under_2_years_before and exactly_2_years_before lie in A's within_2_years (1 day to 2 years, A CONVERSION.md:51-57).

Joint rows map person by person. A one-person return in B has person 2 not_applicable; A puts the same taxpayer in person 2 for single returns (A CONVERSION.md:63-65) and the deceased spouse for surviving-spouse returns (A :66-67), which B fixes to person_ok_1 (B CONVERSION_2.md:73-77). B rows with a partly filled person 2 on a one-person return have no counterpart.
